prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training recovery with high energy availability for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus snacks for a full day
Total daily calories align with endurance athlete needs (approximately 3000-3500 kcal)
Macronutrient distribution supports endurance training (60% carbs, 20% protein, 20% fat)
Meals are practical, compact descriptions suitable for a 1-day reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional endurance athlete (marathon runner) with high caloric needs and specific macronutrient ratios for training recovery
